name: Close-grip push-up

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower — elbows tucked to your ribs

formTips: Hands shoulder-width or a little narrower, under your chest
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body stays straight from head to heels
Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides as you lower
Lower until your chest is just above your hands
Push back up until your arms are straight, without locking the elbows
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides
Hands so close they strain the wrists
Cutting the range short at the bottom
